options.name: --timeout-ms
options.semantics: Deadline per verification including declared dependency sampling

modes.notes: Checks are executed as actual /bin/sh -c commands in recorded cwd. Declared dependencies use BLAKE3 samples before and after; undeclared inputs and atomic filesystem snapshots are not guaranteed. Only current-scope assertions are verified. Unscoped legacy records are preserved but not executed. Status is read-only and does not promote an old success without current evidence. Supervisor destroy_checked must confirm actual descendant quiescence before COMPLETE; cleanup_errno remains observable. Nonzero completed verification is COMPLETE/status1/errors0; timeout/IO/quiescence failure is FAILED. Each verification result is flushed before another check; broken delivery stops batch before persistence. Atomic publication exposes applied/durable, including phase faults and changed store namespace. Build24 native13 passed. Each legacy harness ran23 tests:22 passed and one portable-path case skipped on Linux, for both isolated real-C and actual shell paths.

argument_constraints: Options recognized before -- even after operands. Short flags can be bundled; option values remain indivisible argv tokens. Unknown or conflicting JSON/native selectors fail explicitly.
A provided -e/--regexp pattern makes all positional operands sources; repeated and newline-separated patterns form a union, preserving independent BRE/ERE/fixed grammar.
Matcher precedence: fuzzy, then smart, then fixed, then PCRE-lite, then ERE, then BRE. -G is accepted compatibility default and does not clear another engine flag.
Heuristic fuzzy/smart engines are always case-insensitive and use their own literal rules; -i/-w/-x do not alter those engines.
Result precedence: quiet > files-without-match > count > files-with-matches > spans or selected lines. Context is emitted only in line/span modes.
Explicit file symlinks are followed and named identity revalidated; recursive symlink entries are skipped. Filters and --since apply to regular files encountered by recursive walk.
Cooperative protocol cancellation is admitted only when the output selector is the first argument. Named FIFO operands are rejected; stdin pipe polling checks control every 50ms.
No external command or human-output capture/reparse participates in these structured variants.
resource_limits.presentation_budget: The historical match array bypasses JASH_LLM_BUDGET and uses checked delivery; encoding or sink failure returns 125. Source, line, match-text and row limits remain active. No whole-document presentation-byte budget is applied to this projection.

modes.notes: Historical exact-match shape retained. Line/col are one based; spans are zero-based bytes with exclusive end. JSON retains at most4000 match bytes and discloses match_truncated; explicit JSON paging selects the semantic-query document. A semantic query is selected by any count/list/invert/quiet/context/fuzzy/smart flag, absent source operands or explicit stdin operand -, or by explicit --offset/--limit in JSON mode. Otherwise the historical exact-match shape is retained. --since uses the bounded shared chain store reader; a malformed/FIFO source fails before matches. modes.notes: Same deterministic inference and verification helpers as legacy; bounded previews and excluded self-records declared. Distill atomic publication observes applied/durable, lock wait cooperative, no partial inference save; attest requested does not verify persistence. Verify checks recorded references/session/outcomes/counts/timestamps, not cryptographic chain or truth of heuristics. Brief reuses gap and mesh checked real collectors; graph is metadata observation only. Build26b mem15 GREEN: zero-based ledger distills, reloads and verifies; duplicate or negative sequences fail before overwriting stored data. The held-publication-lock cancellation gate also passed outside the sandbox after the sandbox blocked Python socket.sendall with EPERM; the rejected sandbox run is retained as evidence, not counted as a runtime failure or a passing run.
